title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew ☕ — Sunday, September 13, 2026

🌤️ Weather
Showers and a possible thunderstorm this morning (rain chance 100%, locally heavy), then variable clouds and easing showers this afternoon. High 82°F, low near 70°F, muggy. What to bring: umbrella + a rain jacket this morning — it clears later but stays humid.

🗞️ Headlines
• Iran says a US attack on an Iranian commercial ship in the Strait of Hormuz killed one crew member — tensions climbing.
• Russia launched 450+ drones in overnight strikes across Ukraine.
• Venice Film Festival wraps: "Woman Unknown" by May el-Toukhy takes the Golden Lion for best film.
• EU flags outnumbered Union Jacks at the BBC's Last Night of the Proms, reigniting a culture-war flap in the UK.
• Major US outlets (CNN, NPR, NBC) running rolling Sunday political coverage — nothing single-story dominating the morning.

🚇 Getting around
Busy weekend for transit. LIRR isn't running between Atlantic Terminal and Jamaica all weekend (free subway transfers at several Manhattan/Brooklyn stations). Subway: no trains Hunts Point Av–125 St (shuttle buses), Court Sq–Bedford-Nostrand Avs suspended, and late-night gaps Whitehall St–Atlantic Av-Barclays Ctr. Check before you head out.

🎉 NYC today
• Wu-Tang Forever: The Final Chamber at Jones Beach Theater (7:30 PM).
• Chayanne — "Bailemos Otra Vez" tour at UBS Arena (7:00 PM).
• Last day: free "Devil Wears Prada 2" costume & jewelry exhibition at Christie's, 20 Rockefeller Center.

💡 Nugget
A Swedish company is giving dead wind turbines a second life — turning retired blades and components into tiny houses and sporting gear. Recycling at industrial scale.

Sources: AccuWeather / NWS, Euronews, MTA Weekender, DoNYC/Time Out.
